record.bible_text: And now, O ye priests<WH03548>, this commandment<WH04687> <FI>is<Fi> for you.

If ye will not hear<WH08085><WTH8799>, and if ye will not lay<WH07760><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> to heart<WH03820>, to give<WH05414><WTH8800> glory<WH03519> unto my name<WH08034>, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, I will even send<WH07971><WTH8765> a curse<WH03994> upon you, and I will curse<WH0779><WTH8804> your blessings<WH01293>: yea, I have cursed<WH0779><WTH8804> them already, because ye do not lay<WH07760><WTH8802> <FI>it<Fi> to heart<WH03820>.

Behold, I will corrupt<WH01605><WTH8802> your seed<WH02233>, and spread<WH02219><WTH8765> dung<WH06569> upon your faces<WH06440>, <FI>even<Fi> the dung<WH06569> of your solemn feasts<WH02282>; and <FI>one<Fi> shall take you away<WH05375><WTH8804> with it. <RF>corrupt: or, reprove<Rf> <RF>spread: Heb. scatter<Rf> <RF>one...: or, it shall take you away to it<Rf>

And ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I have sent<WH07971><WTH8765> this commandment<WH04687> unto you, that my covenant<WH01285> might be with Levi<WH03878>, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>.

My covenant<WH01285> was with him of life<WH02416> and peace<WH07965>; and I gave<WH05414><WTH8799> them to him <FI>for<Fi> the fear<WH04172> wherewith he feared<WH03372><WTH8799> me, and was afraid<WH02865><WTH8738> before<WH06440> my name<WH08034>.

The law<WH08451> of truth<WH0571> was in his mouth<WH06310>, and iniquity<WH05766> was not found<WH04672><WTH8738> in his lips<WH08193>: he walked<WH01980><WTH8804> with me in peace<WH07965> and equity<WH04334>, and did turn<WH07725><WH00> many<WH07227> away<WH07725><WTH8689> from iniquity<WH05771>.

For the priest's<WH03548> lips<WH08193> should keep<WH08104><WTH8799> knowledge<WH01847>, and they should seek<WH01245><WTH8762> the law<WH08451> at his mouth<WH06310>: for he <FI>is<Fi> the messenger<WH04397> of the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>.

But ye are departed<WH05493><WTH8804> out of the way<WH01870>; ye have caused many<WH07227> to stumble<WH03782><WTH8689> at the law<WH08451>; ye have corrupted<WH07843><WTH8765> the covenant<WH01285> of Levi<WH03878>, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>. <RF>stumble at: or, fall in<Rf>

Therefore have I also made<WH05414><WTH8804> you contemptible<WH0959><WTH8737> and base<WH08217> before all the people<WH05971>, according<WH06310> as ye have not kept<WH08104><WTH8802> my ways<WH01870>, but have been partial<WH05375><WTH8802><WH06440> in the law<WH08451>. <RF>have been...: or, lifted up the face against: Heb. accepted faces<Rf><CM>

Have we not all one<WH0259> father<WH01>? hath not one<WH0259> God<WH0410> created<WH01254><WTH8804> us? why do we deal treacherously<WH0898><WTH8799> every man<WH0376> against his brother<WH0251>, by profaning<WH02490><WTH8763> the covenant<WH01285> of our fathers<WH01>?

Judah<WH03063> hath dealt treacherously<WH0898><WTH8804>, and an abomination<WH08441> is committed<WH06213><WTH8738> in Israel<WH03478> and in Jerusalem<WH03389>; for Judah<WH03063> hath profaned<WH02490><WTH8765> the holiness<WH06944> of the LORD<WH03068> which he loved<WH0157><WTH8804>, and hath married<WH01166><WTH8804> the daughter<WH01323> of a strange<WH05236> god<WH0410>. <RF>loved: or, ought to love<Rf>

The LORD<WH03068> will cut off<WH03772><WTH8686> the man<WH0376> that doeth<WH06213><WTH8799> this, the master<WH05782><WTH8802> and the scholar<WH06030><WTH8802>, out of the tabernacles<WH0168> of Jacob<WH03290>, and him that offereth<WH05066><WTH8688> an offering<WH04503> unto the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>. <RF>the master...: or, him that waketh, and him that answereth<Rf>

And this have ye done<WH06213><WTH8799> again<WH08145>, covering<WH03680><WTH8763> the altar<WH04196> of the LORD<WH03068> with tears<WH01832>, with weeping<WH01065>, and with crying out<WH0603>, insomuch that he regardeth<WH06437><WTH8800> not the offering<WH04503> any more, or receiveth<WH03947><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> with good will<WH07522> at your hand<WH03027>.

Yet ye say<WH0559><WTH8804>, Wherefore<WH04100>? Because the LORD<WH03068> hath been witness<WH05749><WTH8689> between thee and the wife<WH0802> of thy youth<WH05271>, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously<WH0898><WTH8804>: yet <FI>is<Fi> she thy companion<WH02278>, and the wife<WH0802> of thy covenant<WH01285>.

And did not he make<WH06213><WTH8804> one<WH0259>? Yet had he the residue<WH07605> of the spirit<WH07307>. And wherefore one<WH0259>? That he might seek<WH01245><WTH8764> a godly<WH0430> seed<WH02233>. Therefore take heed<WH08104><WTH8738> to your spirit<WH07307>, and let none deal treacherously<WH0898><WTH8799> against the wife<WH0802> of his youth<WH05271>. <RF>residue: or, excellency<Rf> <RF>godly...: Heb. seed of God<Rf> <RF>treacherously: or, unfaithfully<Rf>

For the LORD<WH03068>, the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> that he hateth<WH08130><WTH8804> putting away<WH07971><WTH8763>: for <FI>one<Fi> covereth<WH03680><WTH8765> violence<WH02555> with his garment<WH03830>, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>: therefore take heed<WH08104><WTH8738> to your spirit<WH07307>, that ye deal not treacherously<WH0898><WTH8799>. <RF>that he...: or, if he hate her, put her away<Rf> <RF>putting...: Heb. to put away<Rf>

Ye have wearied<WH03021><WTH8689> the LORD<WH03068> with your words<WH01697>. Yet ye say<WH0559><WTH8804>, Wherein have we wearied<WH03021><WTH8689> <FI>him<Fi> ? When ye say<WH0559><WTH8800>, Every one that doeth<WH06213><WTH8802> evil<WH07451> <FI>is<Fi>  good<WH02896> in the sight<WH05869> of the LORD<WH03068>, and he delighteth<WH02654><WTH8804> in them; or, Where <FI>is<Fi> the God<WH0430> of judgment<WH04941>?<CM>
